output$my.table <- renderDataTable({

messages.subject: Re: two datatables next to each other
parts:
I just experimented with the new layout features in the development
version of shiny (announced at
https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/shiny-discuss/pBn8TnF3amg),
and it seems to work well:

runApp(list(
ui = fluidPage(fluidRow(
column(6, dataTableOutput('tab1')),
column(6, dataTableOutput('tab2'))
)),
server = function(input, output) {
output$tab1 = renderDataTable(iris)
output$tab2 = renderDataTable(mtcars)
}
))

You can certainly use div(class = 'row-fluid', ...) and div(class =
'span6'), etc, to achieve the same goal.

Regards,
Yihui
